base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high fidelity A-style Themis.ai Matter UI design image, a single coherent screen, portrait 1024x1536 or similar, large readable text suitable for viewing inline on a phone. This is a design concept based on a live full-page survey. Warm paper #f7f5f1, raised white #fffefb, fine #ded9d0 borders, dark ink, Source Serif 4 headings and IBM Plex Sans controls. Compact aligned rows, generous readable content, restrained icons. Amber needs attention, iris dashed borders for agent output, green completed; always text labels. Match the provided A reference style. No gradients, no ornamental dashboards, no tiny multi-screen collage. Common compact header: themis.ai, Matters, Instant payouts Q1, Needs assignment, Tools & history. Common view tabs Understand, Discuss, Draft; Decision map as secondary destination. Keep clear one primary action per region. Footer says Design concept · Sample content. Any legal-looking text is a sample question or limitation, not an invented legal conclusion. Do not invent citations, dates, verified badges, sources or passages. Render all requested controls legibly; shorter body copy is fine, never drop functionality from the named control groups. IMPORTANT: Do not add controls, prerequisites, warnings, source quotas, word limits, or states not explicitly requested. Empty request is the only reason a draft request is disabled. Sources and templates are optional. No invented functionality.

Two stacked fields Current reported fact: Screening runs nightly; Hypothetical value: Screening runs before release. Question for analysis textarea: What changes in the review?
